newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SHARES FALL WITH OVERSEAS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SHARES FALL WITH OVERSEAS.

text.p: * Shares slide in lacklustre afternoon trade, tracking weaker
overseas markets. Seen drifting as no fresh incentives seen
after eight-month reporting season ends. Tieto sets life-high
308.00, up 3.00, on positive analyst comments, but trade thin.

The market was seen drifting with no more major
January-August results in sight, they said.
Data services group Tieto climbed in modest trade to a new
life-high 308.00 markka, up 3.00, supported by a "buy"
recommendation from Kleinwort Benson reported in local press.
Oil group Neste rose past 100.00 markka for the first time
since August 30 amid some overseas demand, brokers said.
